title: Herbal Light American Redcurrant Crumbles
description: A refreshing, herbal twist on the classic crumble featuring redcurrants and a satvik-friendly bain-marie technique.

ingredients.name: Redcurrants
ingredients.notes: Rinse and pat dry before using

instructions: In a large bowl, combine the almond flour, coconut sugar, and salt. Mix until well combined.
Add the softened butter to the dry ingredients and mix until a crumbly mixture forms.
Gently fold in the chopped fresh mint leaves.
Pour the crumble mixture over the redcurrants in a 9x9 inch baking dish.
Bake for 35 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown and the fruit is tender.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with lemon zest.
Let cool for a few minutes before serving, if desired.
Serve warm or at room temperature, garnished with additional fresh mint leaves if desired.
